notes: Bilateral grasp and lift passed; box dropped 0.025 m after 83 wheel-action steps while base moved under 0.001 m.
Direct base stepping worked, but 0.40 m/s limit produced about 0.11 m object lag and bilateral contact loss after 40 steps.
A 6 mm base step reduced instantaneous motion but contact still failed at about 0.10 m cumulative lag, so speed alone is not causal.
Two settle steps per base increment did not recover horizontal lag and increased vertical slip; contact failed after 160 physics steps.
Arm-led cycles did not prevent slip; replay reconstruction showed the left gripper lost one fingerpad after its vertical offset from the box grew to about 0.125 m.
A 20 mm inward insertion exceeded the feasible grasp envelope and prevented bilateral grasp formation.
